description: 10 kohm +/-1% thick-film chip resistor, 0402, 1/16 W at 70 degC, +/-100 ppm/K, 50 V max working (Yageo RC_L)
notes: Benchmark use: buck-3v3 /r2 (R2); esp32s3-devboard /r3, /r4, /r5, /r6 (DNP), /r10 (DNP). Series data sheet record: every rating is the RC0402 standard-power (1/16 W) row of Table 2, which is how Yageo specifies catalogue chip resistors. The MPN's 07 field selects a 7-inch reel at standard power, so the 1/8 W RC0402 row (field 7W, double power) does not apply. Value-specific limits the vendor defines by formula are not separate figures here. The continuous rated voltage is sqrt(P x R) or the maximum working voltage, whichever is less (RATED VOLTAGE, page 7); for this part that is sqrt(625) V = 25 V. A check that holds the terminal voltage to voltage_rating and the dissipation to power_rating applies exactly that rule. The Short Time Overload test applies 2.5 x RCWV or the maximum overload voltage, whichever is less, for 5 s (page 9); for this part that is 2.5 x 25 V = 62.5 V; overload_voltage records the 100 V series ceiling from Table 2. Not recorded because no check reads them: the 100 V dielectric withstanding voltage (terminals to surroundings), the endurance and environmental test limits, packing and marking. Lifecycle: the data sheet states none, and the vendor's product page for this MPN (yageogroup.com/products/Resistors/part/RC0402FR-0710KL, read 2026-10-24) lists the part with stock and sample ordering but no lifecycle field, so the record says unknown rather than inferring active. Source URL: www.yageo.com answers this path with a 301 redirect to the same path on yageogroup.com, a domain Yageo also operates, which served the hashed bytes. The record cites the yageo.com URL because VENDOR_DOMAINS lists only yageo.com for this vendor; curl -L on it reproduces the hash.

pins.description: Terminal 1. The part is symmetric; which terminal is 1 carries no meaning.

provenance.note: Record default; more specific entries override. Yageo RC_L series data sheet, RC0402 1/16 W (standard power) row.

/implements.locator: CONSTRUCTION and Fig. 9 Chip resistor outlines, page 4
/implements.note: The resistor's two ends are the two external terminations of Fig. 9; Resistor's a and b map to terminals 1 and 2, and either orientation is electrically identical.

/mpn.locator: ORDERING INFORMATION - GLOBAL PART NUMBER, page 2
/mpn.note: Read against the vendor's global part number grammar: RC, size 0402, tolerance F (+/-1.0 %), packaging R (paper taping reel), TCR '-' (based on spec), 07 (7-inch reel, standard power), value 10K (R/K/M as the decimal point), default code L. The vendor's site lists this exact MPN (product page and per-part spec sheet on yageogroup.com, 2026-10-24).

/package.locator: ORDERING INFORMATION (1) SIZE, page 2; CONSTRUCTION, Fig. 9 and Table 1 DIMENSION (RC0402 row), page 4
/package.note: 0402 is the MPN's size field; Fig. 9 shows two external terminations, the package's two terminals.

/parameters/resistance.locator: ORDERING INFORMATION (6) RESISTANCE VALUE and (2) TOLERANCE, page 2; Table 2, RC0402 1/16 W row, RESISTANCE RANGE column, page 5
/parameters/resistance.note: Nominal 10 kohm from the MPN's value field 10K, inside the 1 % (E24/E96) range of 1 ohm to 10 Mohm. min and max are the F tolerance (+/-1.0 %) evaluated at that nominal (x 0.99 and x 1.01): arithmetic on stated values, so datasheet-derived. The tolerance itself is /parameters/resistance_tolerance.

/parameters/resistance_tolerance.note: +/-1.0 % written as a fraction of nominal.

/parameters/temperature_coefficient.locator: Table 2, RC0402 1/16 W row, TEMPERATURE COEFFICIENT column (10 ohm < R <= 10 Mohm), page 5; Table 5, Temperature Coefficient of Resistance (T.C.R.) procedure, page 8
/parameters/temperature_coefficient.note: The MPN's TCR field is '-' (based on spec), so the series figure for this resistance band applies: +/-100 ppm per degree Celsius, which is the same coefficient per kelvin. The ta range is the T.C.R. test's temperatures, +25 to -55 degC and +25 to +125 degC (MIL-STD-202 Method 304).

/pins.locator: CONSTRUCTION and Fig. 9 Chip resistor outlines, page 4
/pins.note: The data sheet shows two end terminations and names neither; a chip resistor is a symmetric two-terminal passive, so the terminals are 1 and 2, role passive.

/ratings/abs_max/overload_voltage.locator: Table 2, RC0402 1/16 W row, MAXIMUM OVERLOAD VOLTAGE column, page 5; Table 5 (continued), Short Time Overload, IEC 60115-1 8.1, page 9
/ratings/abs_max/overload_voltage.note: 100 V is the series maximum overload voltage. The Short Time Overload test applies 2.5 x RCWV or this maximum, whichever is less, for 5 seconds at room temperature; the duration condition is that test's. The per-value figure is in the record notes.

/ratings/recommended/ambient_temperature.locator: Table 2, RC0402 1/16 W row, OPERATING TEMPERATURE RANGE column, page 5; FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION, OPERATING TEMPERATURE RANGE (RC0402 to RC2512) and Fig. 10-1, page 7
/ratings/recommended/ambient_temperature.note: Fig. 10-1 plots this range against ambient temperature (Tamb).

/ratings/recommended/power_rating.locator: Table 2, RC0402 1/16 W row, POWER column, page 5; FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION, POWER RATING (rated power at 70 degC) and Fig. 10-1, page 7
/ratings/recommended/power_rating.note: 1/16 W, written exactly as 0.0625 W, at the 70 degC ambient the rating is stated at. Fig. 10-1 holds 100 % of rated power up to 70 degC and derates linearly to zero at 155 degC; only the 70 degC rating is recorded.

/ratings/recommended/voltage_rating.locator: Table 2, RC0402 1/16 W row, MAXIMUM WORKING VOLTAGE column, page 5; FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION, RATED VOLTAGE, page 7
/ratings/recommended/voltage_rating.note: The series maximum working voltage, DC or AC rms. RATED VOLTAGE caps the continuous voltage at sqrt(P x R) where that is less; the per-value figure is in the record notes.
